rationale: ENUM CONSTANT BODIES (owner ruling 2026-10-18, Java-only constructs item: 'enum constant bodies'). JLS 8.9.1: a constant with a body declares an ANONYMOUS SUBCLASS of the enum, and its members belong to that subclass, not to the enum. Pre-fix probe: `enum Mode { ONE { void act() { helper(); } }, TWO; void helper() {} }` produced `contains Mode->act` and NO symbol for the body - the body's members leaked into the enum's containment graph and the body itself did not exist (the exact defect class JD18/JD32 fixed for `new Foo() { ... }`, unfixed for this shape). Fixed the same way: the family's `anonymous_<constant>` noise name, ownerName = the enclosing enum, a pushed scope, and classHierarchy registered to the enum so @Override inside the body has an ancestor to BFS. Authored from semantics before the fix; pins the anonymous symbol, both containment directions (enum -> body, body -> member), the member's owner, the call inside the body sourced at the member, and the @Override resolution the registered hierarchy makes possible.

forbidRelationships.comment: the @Override member at line 6 is declared in ALPHA's body; attributing THAT member to the enum is the leak this fixture closes. The enum's own apply() at line 12 is a different symbol and its contains row is correct, which is why this forbid is line-scoped.
the overriding member belongs to the anonymous body, not to the enum itself
